## DM Sans

Font files DMSans-Regular.ttf and DMSans-Bold.ttf were obtained from the reference Cashew repository's budget/assets/fonts directory. DM Sans is distributed under SIL Open Font License 1.1. See assets/OFL-DMSans.txt for the full license and upstream copyright notice.

Font license reference: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/dmsans/OFL.txt

## HTML application and icons

The HTML/CSS/JavaScript port and its small SVG outline icon set were newly written for this delivery. They are included as source in this package and the standalone HTML. No remote JavaScript/CDN dependencies are required at runtime.

## Optional development dependencies

The optional DOM smoke test uses linkedom 0.18.13 (ISC license) and its dependency tree, installed separately through npm. No linkedom code is bundled in the app or this source archive.
